title: Running Wheel Protocol for Rodent Studies
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yv9fw96
materials: Animal and Equipment monitoring a) During the first day, mice are to be monitored every two hours starting when they are first put into the running wheel cage during MBPs’ normal business hours of 08:00-17:00 Monday-Friday. b) Every day thereafter, animals will be visually checked in the morning before 10:00 and in the afternoon before 17:00. Daily monitoring of mice, food and water intake will continue for the remainder of the study and recorded in the animal and system monitoring log. Environmental conditions will also be checked. i) Any problems will be evaluated with the proper action.

Equipment Set-up a) Starting Run i) Create study folder under “C:\\VitalViewSoftware datasets” ii) Open VV-A program iii) Configure- Load “Running Wheel Template 061516” iv) For each channel makes the following changes as appropriate (a) Chanel name = mouse ID number (b) Chanel group = Genotype /treatment (c) Sample interval bin at 10 min v) Hardware configuration- Board 0 – “off” for 24 cages, “on” for 12 cages vi) Create new/ unique log file path in “C:\\VitalViewSoftware datasets\study #” with added study number and date vii) Save and continue viii) Start (1) “now”- begin instantly (2) “start at” at specific set time (a) After X amount of time after introduced to wheel cage ix) Begin recording and verify sensors are reading activity by active mice. b) Data Export i) Exit (end) program ii) Data Export- AWD- select all animals- save as “ Log file _AWD” iii) Data Export- CVS

steps.title: Acclimate Mice to Running Wheel Cages
steps.instruction: Acclimate mice to running wheel cages in a rodent incubator room or controlled incubator for 24 hours.

substeps.instruction: Fill and place standard food rack and water bottles in running wheel cages before 12:00 PM.
Weigh mice and record weights on the weight and water/food intake log sheet.
Place animals in acclimation cages and record the time in the Animal and System Monitoring Log sheet.
Close the room door and place a 'Testing in Progress' sign on the door.

Maintain room temperature at 22°C (recorded daily) and a 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights off at 18:00, on at 06:00). If using a rodent incubator, maintain temperature between 4 - 37°C as indicated by the study.
Fill out the Animal Monitoring Log Sheet on the door daily.
After 24 hours, grossly observe and document food and water on the Weight/Food/Water Intake Log sheet.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Hardware
steps.instruction: Set up the computer and verify hardware functionality before starting the run.

substeps.instruction: Set up the computer according to section 7.0 procedures.
Spin the wheels to ensure they spin smoothly and the reed switches are reading properly in the software.

steps.title: Initiate Voluntary Running Experiment
steps.instruction: Transition mice to running wheels and begin recording, ensuring all actions occur at the same time of day (before 12:00 PM) to account for circadian rhythms.

substeps.instruction: Replace the standard food rack with an in-cage running wheel with reed switch and food rack (incubator temperature 4 - 37°C if applicable).
Weigh food and animals and record data on the water/food intake log sheet.
Start equipment as described in section 6.0 and note the start time on the Animal Monitoring Log Sheet.
Record for the duration determined by the study design.

steps.title: Maintain Cages During Long-Term Studies
steps.instruction: Perform maintenance for studies lasting longer than 7 days.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect wheels according to section 7.0.
Change cages and water according to UCD Animal Care Policy on Rodent Husbandry for static care.

steps.title: Monitor Consumption and Weight
steps.instruction: Track food consumption and animal weight changes throughout the study.

substeps.instruction: Take food and mouse weights to determine consumption and weight changes.

steps.title: Terminate Study and Process Data
steps.instruction: Stop the recording, export data, and return animals to home cages.

substeps.instruction: In the Vital View program, click Experiment → Stop and export the files.
Weigh animals and return them to their home cages.
Wash and disinfect wheels according to attached protocols.
Wipe down rack surfaces with 10% Nolvasan.
Collect and analyze data.

steps.title: Perform Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify environmental conditions inside the incubator.

substeps.instruction: Measure lux inside the incubator.
Ensure incubator temperature is steady at 22°C or the study-determined temperature (4 - 37°C).
